```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(denguedatahub)
library(ceylon)
library(stringdist)
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(viridis)
library(htmltools)
library(htmlwidgets)


# =========================================================
# 1. DISTRICT-WISE DENGUE DATA
# =========================================================

data(srilanka_weekly_data)
data(district)

# Aggregate weekly data to annual district totals
annual_df <- srilanka_weekly_data %>%
  group_by(year, district) %>%
  summarise(
    annual_cases = sum(cases, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(year == 2025) %>%
  mutate(
    district_clean = toupper(trimws(district))
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Load district polygons
# ---------------------------------------------------------

district_sf <- district %>%
  mutate(
    DISTRICT_clean = toupper(trimws(DISTRICT))
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Fuzzy matching of district names
# ---------------------------------------------------------

annual_df <- annual_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    DISTRICT_match = district_sf$DISTRICT_clean[
      stringdist::amatch(
        district_clean,
        district_sf$DISTRICT_clean,
        maxDist = 3
      )
    ]
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Join annual dengue data to district polygons
# ---------------------------------------------------------

annual_sf <- district_sf %>%
  left_join(
    annual_df,
    by = c("DISTRICT_clean" = "DISTRICT_match")
  ) %>%
  st_transform(4326)


# =========================================================
# 2. MOH AREA DATA
# =========================================================

DengueAtlas1 <- read_excel(
  "dataraw/DengueAtlas.xlsx",
  sheet = 1
)

df_coordinates <- read_csv(
  "dataraw/sri_lanka_areas_coordinates.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  rename(
    HighRiskMOHAreas = area
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Join MOH dengue data with coordinates
# ---------------------------------------------------------

merged_df <- DengueAtlas1 %>%
  left_join(
    df_coordinates,
    by = "HighRiskMOHAreas"
  )


# Make sure Cases is numeric
merged_df <- merged_df %>%
  mutate(
    Cases = as.numeric(Cases)
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Aggregate dengue cases by MOH area
# ---------------------------------------------------------

df_agg <- merged_df %>%
  group_by(
    HighRiskMOHAreas,
    longitude,
    latitude
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    TotalCases = sum(Cases, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Longitude = as.numeric(
      trimws(as.character(longitude))
    ),
    Latitude = as.numeric(
      trimws(as.character(latitude))
    )
  )


# =========================================================
# 3. CLEAN MOH COORDINATES
# =========================================================

# Keep only valid longitude/latitude values
moh_df <- df_agg %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(Longitude),
    is.finite(Latitude)
  )


# Optional: inspect MOH areas that have no coordinates
# df_agg %>%
#   filter(
#     !is.finite(Longitude) |
#     !is.finite(Latitude)
#   )


# =========================================================
# 4. CONVERT MOH LOCATIONS TO SF
# =========================================================

moh_sf <- st_as_sf(
  moh_df,
  coords = c(
    "Longitude",
    "Latitude"
  ),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)


# =========================================================
# 5. ASSIGN EACH MOH AREA TO A DISTRICT
# =========================================================

moh_sf <- st_join(
  moh_sf,
  district_sf %>%
    select(
      DISTRICT,
      DISTRICT_clean
    ),
  join = st_within,
  left = TRUE
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Check MOH areas that could not be assigned
# ---------------------------------------------------------

# moh_sf %>%
#   filter(is.na(DISTRICT)) %>%
#   st_drop_geometry() %>%
#   select(
#     HighRiskMOHAreas,
#     Longitude,
#     Latitude
#   )


# Convert back to regular data frame
moh_df <- moh_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(
    district_clean = DISTRICT_clean
  )


# =========================================================
# 6. COLOUR PALETTES
# =========================================================

district_pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = "YlOrRd",
  domain = annual_sf$annual_cases,
  na.color = "white"
)


moh_pal <- colorBin(
  palette = viridis(7),
  domain = moh_df$TotalCases,
  bins = c(
    1,
    30,
    60,
    100,
    150,
    250,
    500,
    1000,
    2000
  ),
  na.color = "grey"
)


# =========================================================
# 7. DISTRICT MAP
# =========================================================

district_map <- leaflet(
  annual_sf,
  elementId = "district_map"
) %>%

  addTiles() %>%

  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~district_pal(annual_cases),
    fillOpacity = 0.8,

    color = "black",
    weight = 1,

    # This is used to identify the district
    layerId = ~DISTRICT_clean,

    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 3,
      bringToFront = TRUE
    ),

    label = ~paste0(
      DISTRICT,
      ": ",
      format(
        annual_cases,
        big.mark = ","
      ),
      " cases"
    ),

    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>",
      DISTRICT,
      "</b><br>",
      "Dengue cases: ",
      format(
        annual_cases,
        big.mark = ","
      ),
      "<br><br>",
      "<i>Click the district to see its MOH areas.</i>"
    )
  ) %>%

  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = district_pal,
    values = ~annual_cases,
    title = "Dengue Cases<br>(2025)",
    opacity = 1
  ) %>%

  setView(
    lng = 80.7,
    lat = 7.8,
    zoom = 7
  )


# =========================================================
# 8. MOH MAP
# =========================================================

moh_map <- leaflet(
  moh_df,
  elementId = "moh_map"
) %>%

  addTiles() %>%

  addCircleMarkers(

    lng = ~Longitude,
    lat = ~Latitude,

    # Encode district in layer ID
    layerId = ~paste0(
      "moh__",
      district_clean,
      "__",
      HighRiskMOHAreas
    ),

    radius = 7,

    color = ~moh_pal(TotalCases),

    stroke = TRUE,

    fillOpacity = 0.75,

    label = ~paste0(
      HighRiskMOHAreas,
      ": ",
      format(
        TotalCases,
        big.mark = ","
      ),
      " cases"
    ),

    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>",
      HighRiskMOHAreas,
      "</b><br>",
      "District: ",
      DISTRICT,
      "<br>",
      "Dengue cases: ",
      format(
        TotalCases,
        big.mark = ","
      )
    )
  ) %>%

  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = moh_pal,
    values = ~TotalCases,
    title = "Dengue Cases",
    opacity = 1,
    labFormat = labelFormat(
      suffix = " cases"
    )
  ) %>%

  setView(
    lng = 80.7,
    lat = 7.8,
    zoom = 7
  )


# =========================================================
# 9. ADD RESET BUTTON TO MOH MAP
# =========================================================

moh_map <- moh_map %>%

  addEasyButton(
    easyButton(
      icon = "fa-globe",
      title = "Show all MOH areas",

      onClick = JS(
        "
        function(btn, map) {

          map.eachLayer(function(layer) {

            var id = layer.options.layerId;

            if (
              id &&
              id.toString().startsWith('moh__')
            ) {

              layer.setStyle({
                opacity: 1,
                fillOpacity: 0.75
              });

            }

          });

        }
        "
      )
    )
  )


# =========================================================
# 10. CONNECT DISTRICT MAP TO MOH MAP
# =========================================================

district_map <- district_map %>%

  onRender(
    "
    function(el, x) {

      var districtMap = this;

      districtMap.on(
        'click',
        function(e) {

          var districtLayer = e.layer;

          if (
            !districtLayer ||
            !districtLayer.options.layerId
          ) {
            return;
          }

          var selectedDistrict =
            districtLayer.options.layerId;

          /*
           * Find the MOH leaflet widget
           */
          var mohWidget =
            HTMLWidgets.find('#moh_map');

          if (!mohWidget) {
            return;
          }

          var mohMap =
            mohWidget.getMap();


          /*
           * Hide/show MOH areas
           */
          mohMap.eachLayer(
            function(layer) {

              var id =
                layer.options.layerId;

              if (
                !id ||
                !id.toString()
                  .startsWith('moh__')
              ) {
                return;
              }


              var parts =
                id.toString().split('__');


              if (parts.length < 3) {
                return;
              }


              var mohDistrict =
                parts[1];


              /*
               * Show selected district
               */
              if (
                mohDistrict ===
                selectedDistrict
              ) {

                layer.setStyle({
                  opacity: 1,
                  fillOpacity: 0.8
                });

              }

              /*
               * Hide other districts
               */
              else {

                layer.setStyle({
                  opacity: 0,
                  fillOpacity: 0
                });

              }

            }
          );


          /*
           * Zoom the MOH map to
           * the selected district
           */
          var bounds =
            districtLayer.getBounds();

          mohMap.fitBounds(
            bounds,
            {
              padding: [20, 20]
            }
          );

        }

      );

    }
    "
  )


# =========================================================
# 11. SIDE-BY-SIDE LAYOUT
# =========================================================

htmltools::div(

  style = "
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 15px;
    width: 100%;
  ",

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # LEFT: DISTRICT MAP
  # -------------------------------------------------------

  htmltools::div(

    style = "
      flex: 1 1 48%;
      min-width: 450px;
    ",

    tags$h4(
      "District-wise Dengue Cases, 2025",
      style = "
        text-align: center;
        margin-bottom: 5px;
      "
    ),

    tags$p(
      "Click a district to display its MOH areas.",
      style = "
        text-align: center;
        color: #666;
        margin-top: 0;
      "
    ),

    district_map
  ),


  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # RIGHT: MOH MAP
  # -------------------------------------------------------

  htmltools::div(

    style = "
      flex: 1 1 48%;
      min-width: 450px;
    ",

    tags$h4(
      "High-Risk MOH Areas, 2025",
      style = "
        text-align: center;
        margin-bottom: 5px;
      "
    ),

    tags$p(
      "Select a district on the left to filter the MOH areas.",
      style = "
        text-align: center;
        color: #666;
        margin-top: 0;
      "
    ),

    moh_map
  )
)
```
